newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam considers huge urban development project.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam considers huge urban development project.

text.p: Plans for a $997.56 million urban development project on the outskirts of Ho Chi Minh City have been submitted to the government for approval, the official Vietnam News Agency said.
The proposed development, at An Phu-Thu Duc, is a joint venture project between the southern city's Urban Development Service Company and Hong Kong's City Horse Trading Limited.
The news agency said City Horse Trading would contribute 80 percent of the capital. The Vietnamese side would contribute the remainder in the form of land use right on the 90-hectare (222-acre) site.
